logo_override.alt_text: Study in Poland (study.gov.pl) portal logo: red outlined map-pin/book mark containing the words "READY, STUDY Go! POLAND"
logo_override.validation_detail:
HTTP 200, Content-Type image/png, 14699 bytes, 120x120 px. Rendered and inspected visually: red (#E4002B-family) strokes and lettering on a light/transparent ground, so it is legible on white and is NOT a white-on-transparent wordmark. Confirmed as the site-header logo: the only logo emitted inside
in the homepage markup, and the same src on every inner page checked (/erasmus, /scholarships-within-bilateral-agreements). Asset lives on the awarding body's own host study.gov.pl (no CDN, no third-party host).
logo_override._award: Study in Poland / study.gov.pl portal (run by NAWA - Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange; copyright line "NAWA • MNISW"); one portal logo covers both shard records: Konstanty Kalinowski Scholarship Programme (413) and Erasmus+ Programme (423)

notes: METHOD. webfetch of https://study.gov.pl/ returned full Drupal 7 markup (no blocking). Only logo-bearing on the host's own domain: inside div.header-logo > a#logo. No og:image, no msapplication-TileImage, no schema.org logo on the site. Footer identifies the operator as NAWA (Polna 40, Warsaw) with copyright "2014-2026 NAWA / MNISW", so the portal's own campaign mark is the correct in-scope mark, not the European Commission / Erasmus+ programme artwork. PROBED (raw HTTP, status + content-type + bytes): logo_120_0.png = 200 image/png 14699 B 120x120 (ACCEPTED); /sites/default/files/logo_0.png = 200 image/png 12780 B 180x180, the unscaled Drupal source of the identical artwork (verified identical by eye; documented here as the higher-resolution native alternative); /sites/default/files/logo.png = 200 image/png 8572 B 281x53 but REJECTED - visually inspected and it carries a third party's mark, a red open-book graphic with the lettering "EEFG / INTERNATIONAL EDUCATION FAIR GEORGIA" (note: this is not the study.gov.pl mark, so the site file at that generic name is unusable). 404 on /sites/all/themes/Gopoland/img/logo.png, logo_200_0/250_0/270_0/300_0/600_0.png derivatives under sites/default/files/. REJECTED - THIRD-PARTY HOST: the footer's second logo is served from go-poland.pl (/sites/all/themes/Gopoland/img/logo_270.png and logo_w245.png), a different registrable domain, so it fails the same_registrable_domain requirement even though it is the sister Polish government portal. ALTERNATIVE CONSIDERED: https://study.gov.pl/sites/all/themes/Gopoland/img/logo_270.png (200 image/png, 24635 B, 360x44) is NAWA's institutional mark ("NAWA / POLISH NATIONAL AGENCY FOR ACADEMIC EXCHANGE") and is same-domain and legitimate under the brief, but it is NOT the mark the site actually renders in its own header (the header-logo2 block that would host it is commented out in the homepage markup), so the portal's own header mark was preferred. CONTENT FLAG for the merge (outside my logo scope, no files touched): BOTH stored official_source_urls in this shard are dead - https://study.gov.pl/konstanty-kalinowski-scholarship-programme and https://study.gov.pl/erasmus-plus-programme both return HTTP 404. Live equivalents on the same host: /erasmus for Erasmus+ and /scholarships + /scholarships-within-bilateral-agreements for the scholarship overview; note the string "Kalinowski" does not appear on /scholarships-within-bilateral-agreements, so the Konstanty Kalinowski row's award page needs re-location. No repo files other than this output were created or modified.
